territories.name: Civic Wayfinding
territories.thesis: Public information organized with the clarity of a navigational system.
territories.audienceFit: Residents who need a clear next step without understanding city structure.
territories.taskFit: Supports fast orientation, filtering, and service selection.
territories.contentStructure: Task-first service index with status bands and a persistent orientation rail.

structure.hierarchy: Task and next action dominate department context.
structure.navigationModel: Persistent service index and location datum.
structure.interactionModel: Progressive disclosure in predictable service pages.

risks: The datum could become decorative if it does not connect related content.

criterionEvaluations.rationale: Replace with a comparison against the predeclared primary-task criterion.

axes.typography: humanist sans with compact utility labels
axes.composition: asymmetric datum line and left-aligned sections
axes.color: deep civic blue with high-visibility safety accents
axes.imagery: documentary place photography and map fragments
axes.signature: continuous civic datum connecting navigation and content

territories.name: Public Ledger
territories.thesis: Transparent service information presented as a legible public record.
territories.audienceFit: Evaluators and residents who need confidence in source, status, and accountability.
territories.taskFit: Supports comparison, traceability, and evidence-led decisions.
territories.contentStructure: Evidence bands, source notes, and comparison columns organize the narrative.

structure.hierarchy: Conclusions are visibly linked to supporting evidence.
structure.navigationModel: Numbered record index with source cross-links.

risks: Dense record treatment could slow urgent service tasks.

criterionEvaluations.rationale: Replace with a comparison against the predeclared primary-task criterion.

axes.typography: editorial serif display with neutral reading face
axes.composition: modular columns with explicit evidence bands
axes.density: dense information with deliberate breathing zones
axes.color: archival ivory, ink, and restrained vermilion
axes.imagery: scanned documents, civic marks, and annotated diagrams
axes.signature: source notes and evidence markers integrated into the layout

territories.name: Living Commons
territories.thesis: A welcoming service surface shaped by local participation and shared places.
territories.audienceFit: Residents who need reassurance, plain language, and a welcoming route into services.
territories.taskFit: Supports discovery through place, story, and contextual guidance.
territories.contentStructure: Image-led entry points flow into contextual task panels and local guidance.

structure.hierarchy: Life situations precede internal program categories.
structure.navigationModel: Contextual paths connected by a neighborhood map.

risks: Welcoming imagery could compete with task clarity if overused.

criterionEvaluations.rationale: Replace with a comparison against the predeclared primary-task criterion.

axes.typography: rounded display face paired with open humanist body text
axes.composition: layered editorial flow with contextual side notes
axes.geometry: soft organic shapes with selective hard anchors
axes.color: landscape greens, warm clay, and clear sky neutrals
axes.imagery: people, local materials, and place-based close details
axes.signature: contextual neighborhood trail that changes with the task
